payload.description:
# Implement deterministic Anth.us publication handoff

## Purpose

Generate the Anth.us CMS artifact from approved pod copy while preserving the pod as the single editable source.

## Deliverables

- Convert a valid article artifact and approved front matter into the expected Anth.us MDX path and shape.
- Stamp a generated-file marker and stable source-story identity into front matter.
- Refuse publication before required editorial stages are complete.
- Make repeated publication byte-for-byte equivalent for unchanged source.
- Avoid governing or rewriting existing hand-authored Anth.us posts.
- Coordinate any destination-repository changes through that repository workflow when implementation begins.

## Implements

- PPY-a53992: deterministic publication.

## Verification

Executable scenarios cover successful generation, early refusal, stable regeneration, and absence of duplicate output.
payload.title: Implement deterministic Anth.us publication handoff
